about.summary: Frontend Engineer with 1.5+ years of experience building production-ready web applications, admin dashboards, and business platforms. I specialize in React.js and Next.js, with a passion for clean architecture, scalable interfaces, and seamless API integration.
about.philosophy: I believe great software is built at the intersection of clean code and thoughtful design. Every component should have a single responsibility, every interface should be intuitive, and every application should perform as well as it looks.
about.currentFocus: Currently building production apps at Target Digital Solution, focusing on Next.js, performance, and scalable component architecture.
